::: {#sol-where-dl-fits}

Each of the four fields contains the next, as @fig-nested-fields shows,
so all four programs are [artificial intelligence](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/course-overview.html#def-artificial-intelligence),
the last three are [machine learning](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/course-overview.html#def-machine-learning),
the last two are [representation learning](#def-representation-learning),
and only AlexNet is [deep learning](#def-deep-learning):

- The hand-written spam filter follows rules and learns nothing from data.
- The classifier on center ink and left ink learns the digit averages from data,
  but a person chose its [features](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/course-overview.html#def-feature).
- The classifier on PCA features learns its features too,
  but only one layer of them.
- AlexNet learns eight layers, each computed from the one before.

:::
